section1.title: Guinea-Bissau: Escola Bom Samaritano | Completed
section1.description: Our first partner project began in <purple>Bantandja</purple>, a small village in the far east of Guinea-Bissau with about 646 inhabitants. The community faces <purple>an illiteracy rate of over 70%, a monthly income of less than 15 dollars, food insecurity, and an almost total lack of basic infrastructure</purple>, such as schools and healthcare.
section1.description2: We, the <purple>OÁSIS Family</purple>, joined forces with <purple>Escola Bom Samaritano</purple> and, thanks to the generosity of each Oasis partner, we were able to support the construction of a school that now welcomes children in need from the region, offering education, food, and a place of welcome and hope.
section1.description2b: Some words come before any news, and this is one of them: <purple>thank you.</purple> Thank you for believing. Thank you for giving your time, your money, and your prayers to something that often happens far from your eyes but close to your hearts. It is because of <purple>each of you </purple>that we have something tangible to share through this project.
section1.description3: <purple>What your help covered:</purple> All the building materials and labor needed to complete this work were secured with your contributions. Every brick, every bag of cement, every hour of work: it was all possible thanks to you. The well was the longest and most demanding stage. When we think about everything it took to get here, the word that comes to mind is: Gratitude. <purple>Today, there is a school in operation!</purple>

item1.title: Fundraising
item1.description:
Construction fundraising campaign: 50.000€: ~R$318,595.92
  • Sound system for the classrooms
  • Construction of a kitchen, dining hall, bathrooms, and a house for teachers
  • Artesian well for the water supply
  • Purchase of furnishings, including tables, chairs, cabinets, a stove, and a refrigerator
  • Installation of solar panels for a sustainable energy supply
  • Protective wall around the school

item2.title: Construction of School Infrastructure
item2.description: Build and equip the school to meet the needs of children in the Bantandja area, from hiring local construction teams to supervising the progress of the work to ensure quality and safety.

item3.title: Hiring Teachers
item3.description: Ensure a qualified teaching team that is aligned with the values and vision of Oasis and is validated by the Guinean educational curriculum.

item4.title: Student Admissions
item4.description: Admit 150 children to the school in two shifts (morning and afternoon), using a screening process to ensure the inclusion of children in the most vulnerable situations.

item5.title: Official Inauguration of the School
item5.description: Celebrate the school’s inauguration with the local community and monitor its operations on an ongoing basis. A key focus is ensuring that students are fed during school hours.

item6.title: Project Sustainability
item6.description: Launch the 'Educate a Child' campaign, in which supporters contribute monthly to sustain a student’s education and expand the school, reaching more members of the community.

item1.title: Who We Are
item1.description: The <purple>Oasis for the Nations</purple> is a nonprofit organization, guided by Christian principles, based in Portugal and Brazil. Our mission is to support communities in situations of vulnerability around the world, expanding children’s access to education and promoting sustainable development. We completed our first project in the community of Bantandja, in Guinea-Bissau, Africa, where we supported the construction of Escola Bom Samaritano.

item2.title: Our Vision
item2.description: <purple>Our purpose</purple> is to break generational cycles of poverty by offering hope and real opportunities to children in situations of vulnerability.

item3.title: Our Mission
item3.description: <purple>We believe</purple> that every child has the right to LEARN, GROW, and DREAM of a different future.

item1.title: Hope
item1.description: We nurture hope by offering tangible opportunities for growth, stability, and a renewed sense of possibility.

item2.title: Faith
item2.description: We believe in placing firm trust in God, guiding our actions with integrity, compassion, and humility.

item3.title: Transformation
item3.description: We believe in the transformative power of education to equip individuals with the tools and confidence they need to shape their destinies and contribute positively to society.
